published_source: Printed Table 2, column (4) (Early adopters) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2021.02026.pdf), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' full-data code output (the shipped log) to the printed decimals; the authors' code re-run on the shipped 10 percent random seller sample gives 0.032621 (0.034468), N 85514, which differs because of the subsample. Earlier: PanelMainAnalysis.R line 92 (TOT_1wkAdopters); full-data log logPanelMainAnalysis_Lines1_105.txt.
replication_status: approximate (random_subsample: the package ships a 10 percent random seller sample, so the printed full-data value is not reproducible from the shipped data; printed Table 2, column (4) (Early adopters) 0.036 (0.011), N 864,685; the authors' full-data log 0.03565 (0.01121), N 864685, equals it to the printed decimals; the authors' code re-run on the shipped sample gives 0.032621 (0.034468), N 85514, same sign, a gap of 9 percent of the printed value, within 1.96 subsample SEs (z = -0.09); verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: gvar = gweek = first panel week with SHaccess = 1 (NA for the Aug 8 never-treated-in-window group), computed on the full balanced seller-week panel before any sample restriction, so cohorts stay correct in the unbalanced Price/Feedback samples (deriving the adoption week from the first observed treated row in the Price>0 sample produced 13 spurious cohorts). D = 1[week >= gweek] equals the authors' SHaccess row by row in every regression sample. POST-TREATMENT SAMPLE RESTRICTION: sample limited to sellers who opted in to SH within 0-7 days of their access date (Adopt1week == 1; 3,718 sellers in the subsample, of which 730 belong to the never-treated-in-window Aug 8 group). Selection on take-up behaviour observed after assignment; eligible as a sample restriction under the protocol but flagged. Bar-Gill, Brynjolfsson and Hak (2024), eBay Seller Hub (SH) randomized staggered rollout. Seller x week panel, 23 Saturday week-ending dates 2016-03-05..2016-08-06. Treatment SHaccess = 1[WeekEndingDate >= TreatmentDate], absorbing; 6 in-window access cohorts (May 12, May 19, Jun 6, Jun 13, Jun 21, Jul 26 2016 = weeks 11, 12, 15, 16, 17, 22) plus the Aug 8 group, whose access date falls after the last panel week and is therefore never treated in-window (31.3% of sellers). No always-treated units, no switch-offs. Seller FE + week FE, no controls, no weights, SE clustered by seller (authors: lfe::felm, exactDOF=T). DATA: the package ships only a 10% random seller sample (18,422 of 184,222 sellers; 423,706 seller-weeks); the full files need eBay legal approval (README). Prepared panel built by _work/mnsc.2021.02026/build_panel.R, which mirrors PanelMainAnalysis.R lines 15-66; log outcomes precomputed (logSales = log(GMV+1), etc.). published_coef/published_se are the FULL-DATA values from the package log logPanelMainAnalysis_Lines*.txt (stargazer output identical to the published table columns); the article PDF is not in the project so they are unverified against the printed tables. On the 10% sample fixest reproduces the authors' felm line exactly (coefficients identical to 8+ digits, SE identical to 4 digits); the subsample estimate differs from the full-data value by sampling error (SEs about 3.2x larger).
